on.en: He likes to sit on the hairdresser’s chair.
on.zh: 他喜欢坐在理发师的椅子上。

can.en: He can see the speakers’ images.
can.zh: 他能看到演讲者的图像。

section.en: the listening section is not repeated here.
section.zh: 听力部分在此不再重复。

question.en: Good question, but the answer is nothing!
question.zh: 问得好，但答案是什么都没有！

little.en: Joe’s dad said Joe is a really talented little boy.
little.zh: 乔的爸爸说乔是个很有天赋的小男孩。

took.en: She took it to the restaurant manager.
took.zh: 她把它拿给了餐厅经理。

role.en: Tim Peake is stepping down permanently from his role as a European astronaut.
role.zh: 蒂姆·皮克将永久卸任欧洲宇航员的角色。

hand.en: Teach them how to perform tasks with their right hand.
hand.zh: 教他们如何用右手完成任务。

case.en: Whatever the case, your passport will likely be one of four colors: red, blue, green or black
case.zh: 无论情况如何，你的护照很可能是红、蓝、绿、黑四种颜色之一

move.en: The city is too big to move around easily.
move.zh: 这座城市太大，很难轻松地四处走动。

grow.en: They grow and evolve with age.
grow.zh: 它们随着年龄增长而成长和演变。

build.en: Build a Martian habitat in Houston.
build.zh: 在休斯敦建造一个火星居住舱。

full.en: Interesting people are always full of curiosity.
full.zh: 有趣的人总是充满好奇心。

face.en: Do you remember he had a scar on his face?
face.zh: 你还记得他脸上有道疤吗？

service.zh: 为顾客提供一流的服务。

parts.en: sometimes actual orchestras are used for major parts of the opera itself.
parts.zh: 有时歌剧的主要部分甚至会用真正的管弦乐队演奏。

biggest.en: For that age group, our biggest seller this year has been this action figure.
biggest.zh: 对这个年龄段来说，今年我们卖得最好的是这款可动人偶。

leave.zh: 离开这个偏远的寒冷地区。

whatever.en: And whatever their financial background, or their educational background, most people will have something in common with each other.
whatever.zh: 无论经济背景或教育背景如何，大多数人彼此都有共同之处。

added.en: She prefers to have the fee added to her monthly bill.
added.zh: 她希望把这笔费用加到她的月账单里。

run.en: Kids need time every day to run, jump, stretch and play.
run.zh: 孩子们每天都需要时间跑、跳、伸展和玩耍。

looked.en: If you’ve ever looked at the ingredients list while grocery shopping
looked.zh: 如果你在买东西时看过配料表

twice.en: After I fell out of my bed twice during my freshman year
twice.zh: 在我大一那年从床上掉下来两次之后

late.en: And do it today, tomorrow is too late.
late.zh: 今天就做，明天就太晚了。

fit.en: Only fit for families of four or less.
fit.zh: 只适合四人及以下的家庭。

heavy.en: no carrying heavy shopping bags in the rain
heavy.zh: 不用在雨中提着沉重的购物袋

produce.en: The capacity to mass produce it.

nature.en: It is unwise to weaken the human connection to nature.
nature.zh: 削弱人类与自然的联系是不明智的。

side.en: The new market on the other side of town.

paper.en: Paper books are being ignored, in favor of screens.
paper.zh: 纸质书正被冷落，人们更青睐屏幕。

cover.en: Cover public spaces with fruit trees and vegetable plants.
cover.zh: 在公共空间种满果树和蔬菜。
